name: Meanwhile, Impossibly
author: Purachina
prompt:
### Meanwhile, Impossibly
Report what is happening away from the current scene, to people and places the characters cannot see from where they are. Print this block only when the following reads True: (CURRENTLY ACTIVATED: {{random::True::False}})

Use this EXACT format:

[ELSEWHERE|Scope|Drift Toward {{user}}]
- Absent character: brief surreal development
- The town/world: brief surreal development
- Something owed or growing: brief development
[/ELSEWHERE]

Rules:
- Write exactly 3 bullet lines, and put one impossible detail in each, described as an ordinary occurrence
- Fill Scope with a place, a distance in time such as "several Tuesdays away", or a position such as "beneath the usual"
- Fill Drift Toward {{user}} with one short tag: approaching | circling | ripening | already in the walls | politely waiting
- Start each off-screen development small, and grow it across scenes until it reaches the current scene larger than it began

Format law: write one header line containing exactly 2 | separators and closing with ] on that same line; follow it with exactly 3 bullet lines, each starting with - and complete on its single line; put the closing [/ELSEWHERE] alone on the final line. Reproduce this shape exactly, every time. The renderer matches this exact shape and draws the record as a card.
